name: Skimo long climb 65
description: Three long pitches with short transitions, like a real ascent: sustained climbing with brief stops to drink, eat and change layers.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy and smooth. Nose breathing, shoulders loose.

steps.name: Pitch
steps.notes: RPE 5. Hold the same effort every pitch.

steps.name: Transition
steps.notes: Drink, eat, shake out the legs.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Let the breathing settle; sip water.
